See Note 2(a) to the financial statements

column2: How the matter was addressed in our audit

column1:
The Directors have prepared the financial
statements on the basis of accounting
applicable to a going concern.
We considered the application of the going
concern basis of accounting and the
related disclosures in these financial
statements to be a key audit matter due to
the following:
— The losses incurred by the group and
the company in current year;
— The cumulative losses and negative
cashflows from operating activities for
the group and the company as at 31
December 2023;
— The group’s and the company’s
significant borrowings due to mature in
the year to 31 December 2025 and the
measures put in place to resolve
liquidity challenges and raise additional
funds to settle the outstanding
obligations.
Due to the significant judgements made by
the Directors in their evaluation of the
group’s and the company’s ability to
continue as a going concern, we
considered this to be a key audit matter.
column2:
Our audit procedures in this area included, among others:
— evaluation of the Directors’ assessment of the group’s
and the company’s going concern for at least the next
12 months from the approval of these financial
statements by:
— examining the group’s and the company’s financial
forecasts and understanding the underlying
assumptions that the directors have used in preparing
these forecasts. This involved evaluating the
reasonableness of these forecasts based on
evidence provided to support the underlying
assumptions;
— comparing the actual performance for the year ended
31 December 2023 to the budget and prior year in
order to determine the reasonableness of the budgets
and the historical accuracy of management forecasts;
— understanding the debt restructuring agreements with
existing lenders through reading of correspondence
between the Directors, the Insurance Regulatory
Authority (IRA) and the existing lenders;
— evaluation of the adequacy of of the disclosures made
in the financial statements in respect of judgements
and plans made with respect to going concern
